title: [finding] docs: query-syntax.mdx "Filtering Across Relationships" says SqlDriver compiles a nested relation object and emits a dotted key to Knex — both are refused at the engine before any driver since 4b4ee88f
body:
Filing gate: **① a published docs sentence measured false**, with a named landing site.

`reach:` `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` ships as a product docs page. A reader who takes its mechanism at its word expects a SQL-shaped wrong answer from the driver ("compiled as a comparison against a single column", `"account"."industry"` against an unjoined table). What the platform actually returns is a loud 400 from the engine.

Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat 1 (`session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`, seat post #7623). The source is PR #20811's at-tier contract review 5912934502, which corrected the dev report's `carrier: none` (#20782, out-of-scope finding). PR #20811 is `skills/**` only; its claim held `content/docs/**` read-only. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The text (at `origin/main`)

`query-syntax.mdx:602-:611`, the "Filtering Across Relationships" warning callout:
- **True:** the headline, "Relation traversal inside `where` is not supported".
- **True:** the two-query example after it (`:612-:623`: `fields: ['id']`, then `$in` on the local key).
- **Stale:** the mechanism sentences `:605-:610`, "`SqlDriver.applyFilters()` only recognises a nested object as an operator map when its keys start with `$`; anything else is compiled as a comparison against a single column of the queried table, and a dotted key is emitted verbatim, so Knex renders it as `"account"."industry"` against a table that was never joined."

## What is true at the code

- The nested form beneath a relation field (`lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`, `tree`) is refused by the engine before any driver is resolved, with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 on every driver. The code is `packages/objectql/src/no-operator-object-door.ts`, since `4b4ee88f` (PR #20781). It is pinned in `packages/objectql/src/engine-nested-object-door.test.ts` and `packages/rest/src/data-nested-object-door.test.ts`.
- A dotted `where` path is refused earlier still, with `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 (`classifyDottedFilterHead`, the #8371 door).
- The engine's refusal names the served route itself: query the related object, then `$in` its ids, or `$contains` per id on a `multiple: true` lookup.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

Replace the mechanism sentences with the refusal as shipped (the engine refuses both forms with 400 and names the route), and keep the headline and the two-query example. On a `multiple: true` lookup, use `$contains` per id. That matches `skills/objectstack-query` after PR #20811.

Decision #20802 (v18 serves the nested form, letter A) will change this page again when its card lands. Until then the page states 17.x behaviour.

Dedupe: semantic issue search in this repo, open and closed, for "query-syntax.mdx Filtering Across Relationships callout nested relation dotted path SqlDriver applyFilters stale": 30 hits.
- #20782 (the skill half) and #20745 (the engine refusal, closed) are the same family.
- None is about this page.
